data.gender_notes: Malam is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Malam is a unisex name of Sanskrit and Tamil origin, derived from the Sanskrit word 'malam' which means night or moon. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby, evoking feelings of peace, calm, and the mysteries of the night. The name Malam carries the meaning “Night, moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Malam usually hope their child will grow to embody night, moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Malam is a sacred name in Hinduism, associated with the Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. It is believed that calling upon the name Malam can bring peace, abundance, and protection.
data.etymology: Malam belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night, moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Malam total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
